content:
maria: quick heads-up — after the kernel selector rollout (v2.14) we saw Mixtral MoE p95 jump on short-seq (<=128) traffic. Observed on dedicated pools in us-west.

aj: ugh. saw similar in staging earlier today. p95 doubled? any flamegraphs?

kai: can you paste a sampling trace or the router logs? looking for slow-path / expert-queue stalls.

maria: pasting trimmed trace + router log snippet. TL;DR: more router slow-paths, expert cache miss rate up ~3x, kernel fallback to generic matmul for a few hot ops.

maria: ```
# perf top snapshot (short-seq mixtral)
Samples: 10K, Interval: 1s
 24.1% mixtral::router::dispatch_slow_path
 18.7% kernels::softmax_atomic_generic
 15.4% kernels::kv_cache_eviction
 12.0% kernels::rope_scaled_matmul_fast (was ~28% pre-rollback)
  7.9% dispatch::expert_forward_wait
```

maria: router log: "selected_route=topk(1), kernel=generic, cache_hit=false, expert_parallelism=4, queue_len=42" repeated during the spike.

aj: interesting — rope_scaled_matmul_fast dropped in time share which implies selector is preferring a different kernel for small seqs. maybe the new selection policy uses sequence-length distribution but mis-classified short batches as long?

lee: also note we changed default expert_shard_per_gpu from 1->2 last week for density; that increases cross-device shuffle if we don't adjust sharding handoff paths. Could be extra RPC / serialization overhead.

kai: metrics? throughput and token/s numbers before/after?

perf-bot: automated-summary: pre-rollout (v2.13) short-seq: p95=120ms, p99=400ms, tokens/s=3.5k. post-rollout (v2.14): p95=220ms, p99=780ms, tokens/s=2.1k. Expert-eviction-rate +320%, router_slow_path_rate +4.6x.

maria: exact prometheus queries I used: 
```
rate(router_slow_path_total[5m])
sum(rate(kv_cache_evictions_total[5m])) by (pool)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))
```

aj: two hypotheses: (1) selector change introduced an ordering that pushes small-seq requests into a kernel path that expects larger caching layout (causes cache misses + slow generic softmax), (2) expert sharding change + parallelism increased cross-device tail latency and eviction pressure on per-expert KV.

lee: agree. I saw higher serialized bytes on the inter-gpu transport during the window: tx_bytes/s +60% on host.

kai: quick mitigations we can try for canary:
- force kernel selector to prefer rope_scaled_matmul_fast for seq<=256 (selector override)
- reduce expert_parallelism to 1 for the canary pool
- raise kv_cache_capacity for Mixtral experts by 20%
- lower router topk from 2->1 for short seq to reduce expert fanout

maria: trying override now in canary config: `KERNEL_SELECTOR_OVERRIDES='seq<=256:rope_scaled_matmul_fast'` applying to pool 'dedicated-us-west-canary'. will monitor.

ops-bot: deploy started: canary config applied to dedicated-us-west-canary.

maria: preliminary: p95 back down to ~135ms, tokens/s up to ~3.0k, eviction-rate trending down. still a bit higher than pre-roll (likely due to density changes).

aj: good. long-term we need to:
- add unit tests for selector heuristics that simulate skewed seq-length distributions
- add a metric for kernel-selector-change-impact (per kernel CPU/GPU time share)
- add gating so selector rollout requires no >10% p95 uplift on short-seq perf tests

kai: for the expert-sharding problem we should also test rebalancing knobs: experimental set: `expert_parallelism=1`, `expert_batching_window_ms=4`, `kv_cache_capacity_multiplier=1.2`. I can run a grid.

lee: another datapoint — RoPE scaling parameter change we merged earlier (ropecfg.scale_coeff default bumped) increases memory layout variance which can push certain matmul kernels off their fast path if shape alignment differs. We should pin ropecfg for Mixtral until selector logic accounts for it.

maria: noted. I'll open two PRs: (A) selector tests + gating, (B) revert selector rule for seq<256 and add explicit mapping.

aj: also add a small profiler endpoint to fetch current kernel-selection decisions for a given request (so we can reproduce quickly). Example endpoint: `/debug/kernel-choice?model=mixtral&seq=64&topk=1`.

maria: I'll own the canary monitoring dashboard and the PRs. thanks for the fast triage.

lee: filing follow-ups: 
- ENG-RUNTIME ticket for kernel-selector unit tests
- PERF epic for expert sharding perf regression

maria: tl;dr: rollout caused kernel mis-selection + increased expert KV pressure after expert_shard density change. Canary override shows mitigation. Next: tests + gating and sharding tuning. :thumbsup:

aj: :thumbsup: ping me if you want help with the unit tests or the profiler endpoint.

perf-bot: note: scheduled regression job will run tonight across mixtral mix of seqs and expert configs. results posted to #perf-reports.

maria: closing the loop here — will post a short postmortem after the PRs land.
